<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><U>MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">THIS MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT
(this &ldquo;<U>Agreement</U>&rdquo;), dated as of [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>], 2026 (the &ldquo;<U>Effective Date</U>&rdquo;), is by and among Angel Oak
Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the &ldquo;<U>Company</U>&rdquo;), Angel Oak Residential Operating Partnership
L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the &ldquo;<U>Operating Partnership</U>&rdquo;), and Angel Oak Capital Advisors, LLC, a Delaware
limited liability company (the &ldquo;<U>Manager</U>&rdquo; and together with the Company and the Operating Partnership, the &ldquo;<U>Parties</U>&rdquo;).
Capitalized terms used herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in Section&nbsp;1 below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>W I T N E S S E T H</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the Company intends
to qualify as a REIT, and to invest its funds in investments permitted by the terms of Sections&nbsp;856 through 860 of the Code;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the Company is the
general partner of the Operating Partnership and intends to conduct all of its business and make all or substantially all Investments
through the Operating Partnership;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the Company and
the Operating Partnership desire to avail themselves of the knowledge, experience, sources of information, advice, assistance and certain
facilities available to the Manager and to have the Manager undertake the duties and responsibilities hereinafter set forth, on behalf
of, and subject to the supervision of, the Board, all as provided herein; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the Manager is willing
to undertake to render such services, subject to the supervision of the Board, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration
of the foregoing and of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, the parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">1.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Definitions</B></FONT>.
As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the definitions hereinafter indicated:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Acquisition
Expenses</U></B>&rdquo; shall mean any and all expenses, exclusive of Acquisition Fees, incurred by the Company, the Operating Partnership,
the Manager or any of their respective Affiliates either in connection with the selection, evaluation, structuring, acquisition, origination,
financing and development of any assets, whether or not acquired, including, without limitation, &nbsp;(i)&nbsp;legal fees and expenses,
(ii)&nbsp;travel and communications expenses, (iii)&nbsp;credit analysis, underwriting review, loan-level due diligence and pricing analytics
costs, (iv)&nbsp;costs of property appraisals and broker price opinions on collateral underlying mortgage loans, (v)&nbsp;accounting,
tax and consulting fees and expenses, (vi)&nbsp;costs of contracting with third parties (including Affiliates of the Manager) for the
servicing and special servicing of mortgage loans, (vii)&nbsp;costs and expenses related to structuring securitization vehicles and the
transactions related to the purchase and sale of mortgage loans to or by the Company and any securitization vehicle, including rating
agency fees, trustee fees and underwriting fees, (viii)&nbsp;costs and expenses incurred in connection with warehouse financing, repurchase
agreements and other financing facilities for mortgage loans pending securitization, and (ix)&nbsp;all other out-of-pocket costs and
expenses actually incurred in connection with the pursuit, making, holding, settling, monitoring or disposing of actual or potential
Investments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 3 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Acquisition
Fee</U></B>&rdquo; shall mean any and all fees and commissions, exclusive of Acquisition Expenses, paid by any Person to any other Person
(including any fees or commissions paid by or to any Affiliate of the Company or the Manager) in connection with making or investing
in Investments, including loan origination fees, points, brokerage commissions, selection fees, finder&rsquo;s fees or any other fees
of a similar nature;&nbsp;<I>provided</I>, that Acquisition Fees shall not include (i)&nbsp;origination fees or points payable by borrowers
to Angel Oak Mortgage Solutions, LLC (or any other originator which is an Affiliate of the Manager) in connection with the origination
of mortgage loans, or (ii)&nbsp;customary underwriting fees and placement agent fees payable to Affiliates of the Manager in connection
with the structuring and distribution of securities in securitization transactions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Affiliate</U></B>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Angel Oak</U></B>&rdquo;
means, collectively, the Manager and any Affiliate thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Board</U></B>&rdquo;
shall mean the board of trustees of the Company, as of any particular time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

shall mean, with respect to the termination of this Agreement, fraud, willful misconduct, or willful or negligent breach of fiduciary
duty by the Manager in connection with performing its duties hereunder.</P>

and re-performing mortgage loans, (ix)&nbsp;residential transitional loans, (x)&nbsp;reverse mortgage loans, (xi)&nbsp;commercial real
estate mortgage loans, and (xii)&nbsp;any other residential or commercial mortgage loans, in each case whether acquired from Affiliate
originators (including Angel Oak Mortgage Solutions, LLC and its affiliates) or from unaffiliated third-party mortgage companies and

Partnership directly or indirectly through one or more of their Affiliates: (i)&nbsp;residential mortgage-backed securities (including
agency and non-agency RMBS); (ii)&nbsp;commercial mortgage-backed securities; (iii)&nbsp;collateralized mortgage obligations; (iv)&nbsp;commercial
and residential asset-backed securities; (v)&nbsp;credit risk transfer notes and synthetic credit risk transfer instruments; (vi)&nbsp;retained
interests (including subordinated, mezzanine, junior and interest-only tranches) in securitization transactions in which the Company
or any Affiliate participates; (vii)&nbsp;structured credit instruments, including certificates issued by structured investment vehicles
that hold pools of mortgage loans or other real estate-related interests; (viii)&nbsp;mortgage derivatives, including mortgage participations,
total return swaps, credit default swaps, interest rate swaps, futures contracts, options, swaptions, caps, floors, forward contracts
and other derivative instruments utilized for investment or hedging purposes; (ix)&nbsp;equity interests in entities owning Real Property
or Mortgages (including real estate owned and equity real estate, whether residential or commercial); (x)&nbsp;consumer loans; and (xi)&nbsp;any
other real estate-related or mortgage-related security, note, instrument, certificate, participation or interest.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<B><U>Valuation Guidelines</U></B>&rdquo;
shall mean the valuation guidelines adopted by the Board, as amended from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">2.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Appointment</B></FONT>.
The Company and the Operating Partnership hereby appoint the Manager to serve as their investment advisor on the terms and conditions
set forth in this Agreement, and the Manager hereby accepts such appointment. By accepting such appointment, the Manager acknowledges
that it has a contractual and fiduciary responsibility to the Company. Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, the Manager hereby
agrees to use its commercially reasonable efforts to perform the duties set forth herein, provided that the Company pays the Manager
the Management Fee described herein and reimburses the Manager for costs and expenses in accordance with the terms hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">3.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Duties
of the Manager</B></FONT>. Subject to the oversight of the Board and the terms and conditions of this Agreement (including the Investment
Guidelines) and consistent with the provisions of the Company&rsquo;s most recent Memorandum, the Declaration of Trust and Bylaws and
the Operating Partnership Agreement, the Manager will have plenary authority with respect to the management of the business and affairs
of the Company and the Operating Partnership (and any subsidiary of the Company or the Operating Partnership) and will be responsible
for implementing the investment strategy of the Company and the Operating Partnership (and any subsidiary). The Manager will perform
(or cause to be performed through one or more of its Affiliates or third parties) such services and activities relating to the selection
of investments and rendering investment advice to the Company, the Operating Partnership and their respective subsidiaries as may be
appropriate or otherwise mutually agreed from time to time, which may include, without limitation:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>serving
as an advisor to the Company and the Operating Partnership with respect to the establishment and periodic review of the Investment Guidelines
for the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s investments, financing activities and operations;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>sourcing,
evaluating and monitoring the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s investment opportunities and executing the acquisition,
management, financing and disposition of the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s assets, in accordance with the Company&rsquo;s
Investment Guidelines, policies and objectives and limitations, subject to oversight by the Board;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>with
respect to prospective acquisitions, purchases, sales, exchanges or other dispositions of Investments, conducting negotiations on the
Company&rsquo;s and Operating Partnership&rsquo;s behalf with sellers, purchasers, and other counterparties and, if applicable, their
respective agents, advisors and representatives, and determining the structure and terms of such transactions;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>providing
the Company and the Operating Partnership with portfolio management and other related services;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(e)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>serving
as the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s advisor with respect to decisions regarding any of their financings, hedging
activities or borrowings, including (1)&nbsp;assisting the Company and the Operating Partnership in developing criteria for debt and
equity financing that is specifically tailored to the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s investment objectives, and
(2)&nbsp;advising the Company and the Operating Partnership with respect to obtaining appropriate financing for the Investments, including
warehouse financing, term securitization funding, repurchase agreements, reverse repurchase agreements, credit facilities and other borrowing
arrangements (which, in accordance with applicable law and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Declaration of Trust and
Bylaws, may include financing by the Manager or its Affiliates) and (3)&nbsp;negotiating and entering into, on the Company&rsquo;s, the
Operating Partnership&rsquo;s and any of the Company&rsquo;s or the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s subsidiary&rsquo;s behalf, financing
arrangements, repurchase agreements, interest rate or currency swap agreements, hedging arrangements, foreign exchange transactions,
derivative transactions, securitization transactions and other agreements and instruments required or appropriate in connection with
the Company&rsquo;s, the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s or such subsidiary&rsquo;s activities;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(f)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>engaging

agents, escrow agents and other service providers (which may include Affiliates of the Manager) that provide various services with respect
to the Company and the Operating Partnership, including, without limitation:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(m)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>determining
valuations for the Company&rsquo;s Investments and calculating, as of the last calendar day of each month, the NAV per Share in accordance
with the Valuation Guidelines, and in connection therewith, as applicable based on the Valuation Guidelines, obtain appraisals performed
by external appraisal firms concerning the value of the Investments and/or obtain market quotations or conduct fair valuation determinations
concerning the value of Investments;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(o)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>monitoring
the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s Investments for events that may be expected to have a material impact on the

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(r)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>placing,
or arranging for the placement of, orders of Investments pursuant to the Manager&rsquo;s investment determinations for the Company and
the Operating Partnership either directly with the issuer or with a broker or dealer (including any Affiliated broker or dealer);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(s)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>performing
such other services from time to time in connection with the management of the Company&rsquo;s investment activities as the Board shall
reasonably request or the Manager shall deem appropriate under the particular circumstances;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(t)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>structuring,
arranging and executing securitization transactions on behalf of the Company and the Operating Partnership, including participation in
securitization transactions in which Other Angel Oak Accounts may also contribute mortgage loans or other assets, and managing the Company&rsquo;s
and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s retained interests in any such securitization transactions;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(u)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>counseling
the Company and the Operating Partnership regarding the maintenance of the Company&rsquo;s qualification as a REIT, monitoring compliance
with the various REIT qualification tests and other rules&nbsp;set out in the Code and regulations promulgated thereunder, and conducting
periodic compliance reviews with respect thereto, including monitoring the Company&rsquo;s compliance with the asset, income, distribution
and ownership requirements applicable to REITs; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(v)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>taking
any of the foregoing actions with respect to any subsidiary of the Company or the Operating Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 11; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->9<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">4.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Authority
of Manager</B></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Pursuant
to the terms of this Agreement (including the restrictions included in this Section&nbsp;4 and in Section&nbsp;7), and subject to the
continuing and exclusive authority of the Board over the management of the Company, the Board (by virtue of its approval of this Agreement
and authorization of the execution hereof by the officers of the Company) hereby delegates to the Manager the authority to take, or cause
to be taken, any and all actions and to execute and deliver any and all agreements, certificates, assignments, instruments or other documents
and to do any and all things that, in the judgment of the Manager, may be necessary or advisable in connection with the Manager&rsquo;s
duties described in Section&nbsp;3, including the making of any Investment that fits within the Investment Guidelines and the discretionary
limits and authority as granted to the Manager from time to time by the Board.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
the foregoing, any Investment that does not fit within the Investment Guidelines will require the prior approval of the Board or any
duly authorized committee of the Board, as the case may be. Except as otherwise set forth herein, in the Investment Guidelines or in
the Declaration of Trust, any Investment that fits within the Investment Guidelines may be made by the Manager on the Company&rsquo;s
or the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s behalf without the prior approval of the Board or any duly authorized committee of the Board.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>To
the extent required, including in accordance with the Declaration of Trust, the prior approval of a majority of the Trustees (including
a majority of the Independent Trustees) not otherwise interested in the transaction will be required for certain transactions to which
the Manager or its Affiliates is a party.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Board will review the Investment Guidelines periodically and may, at any time upon the giving of advance written notice to the Manager,
amend the Investment Guidelines; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that such modification or revocation shall be effective upon agreement
by the Manager or such later date as is specified by the Board and included in the notice provided to the Manager and such modification
or revocation shall not be applicable to investment transactions to which the Manager has committed the Company or the Operating Partnership
prior to the date of receipt by the Manager of such notification, or if later, the effective date of such modification or revocation
specified by the Board.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(e)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager may retain, for and on behalf, and at the sole cost and expense, of the Company or the Operating Partnership, such services as
the Manager deems necessary or advisable in connection with the management and operations of the Company, which may include Affiliates
of the Manager; <I>provided</I>, that any such services may only be provided by Affiliates to the extent such services are provided in
accordance with the Declaration of Trust or otherwise approved by a majority of the Trustees (including a majority of the Independent
Trustees) not otherwise interested in the transaction. In performing its duties under Section&nbsp;3, the Manager shall be entitled to
rely reasonably on qualified experts and professionals (including, without limitation, accountants, legal counsel and other professional
service providers) hired by the Manager at the Company&rsquo;s sole cost and expense.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(f)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager shall use reasonable efforts to keep the Company, including the executive officers of the Company, fully informed of all investment
and other activity carried out pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. The Manager shall coordinate with, and consider any input from,
the Company&rsquo;s executive officer team in order to ensure that the Manager&rsquo;s activities are carried out in a manner consistent
with the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the Investment Guidelines.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">5.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Bank
Accounts</B></FONT>. The Manager may establish and maintain one or more bank accounts in the name of the Company and the Operating Partnership
and any subsidiary thereof and may collect and deposit into any such account or accounts, and disburse from any such account or accounts,
any money on behalf of the Company or the Operating Partnership, consistent with the Manager&rsquo;s authority under this Agreement,
provided that no funds shall be commingled with the funds of the Manager; and the Manager shall from time to time render, upon request
by the Board, its audit committee or the auditors of the Company, appropriate accountings of such collections and payments to the Board,
its audit committee and the auditors of the Company, as applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">6.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Records;
Access</B></FONT>. The Manager shall maintain, or cause to be maintained, appropriate records of its activities hereunder and make such
records, or shall cause such records to be made, available for inspection by the Board and by counsel, auditors and authorized agents
of the Company, at any time or from time to time during normal business hours. The Manager shall at all reasonable times have access
to the books and records of the Company and the Operating Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">7.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Limitations
on Activities</B></FONT>. The Manager shall refrain from any action that, in its sole judgment made in good faith, (i)&nbsp;is inconsistent
with the Investment Guidelines, (ii)&nbsp;would adversely and materially affect the qualification of the Company as a REIT under the
Code or the Company&rsquo;s and the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s status as entities excluded from investment company status under the
Investment Company Act, or (iii)&nbsp;would materially violate any law, rule&nbsp;or regulation of any governmental body or agency having
jurisdiction over the Company and the Operating Partnership or that would otherwise not be permitted by the Declaration of Trust, Bylaws
or Operating Partnership Agreement. If the Manager is ordered to take any action by the Board, the Manager shall seek to notify the Board
if it is the Manager&rsquo;s reasonable judgment that such action would adversely and materially affect such status or violate any such
law, rule&nbsp;or regulation or the Declaration of Trust, Bylaws or Operating Partnership Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, neither
the Manager nor any of its Affiliates shall be liable to the Company, the Operating Partnership, the Board, the Shareholders or the Unitholders
for any act or omission by the Manager or any of its Affiliates, except as provided in Section&nbsp;19 of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">8.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Other
Activities of the Manager</B></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Nothing
in this Agreement shall (i)&nbsp;prevent the Manager or any of its Affiliates, or their respective owners, officers, directors or employees
from engaging in other businesses or from rendering services of any kind to any other Person or entity, whether or not the investment
objectives or policies of any such other Person or entity are similar to those of the Company, including, without limitation, the sponsoring,
closing, advising and/or managing of any Other Angel Oak Accounts, (ii)&nbsp;in any way bind or restrict the Manager or any of its Affiliates,
or their respective owners, officers, directors or employees from buying, selling or trading any securities or commodities for their
own accounts or for the account of others for whom the Manager or any of its Affiliates, or their respective owners, officers, directors
or employees may be acting, or (iii)&nbsp;prevent the Manager or any of its Affiliates from receiving fees or other compensation or profits
from such activities described in this Section&nbsp;8(a)&nbsp;which shall be for the Manager&rsquo;s (or such related Person&rsquo;s)
sole benefit. While information and recommendations supplied to the Company shall, in the Manager&rsquo;s reasonable and good faith judgment,
be appropriate under the circumstances and in light of the investment objectives and policies of the Company, such information and recommendations
may be different in certain material respects from the information and recommendations supplied by the Manager or any Affiliate of the
Manager to others (including, for greater certainty, the Other Angel Oak Accounts and their investors, as described more fully in Section&nbsp;8(b)).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 13; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->11<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager and the Company acknowledge and agree that, notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, (i)&nbsp;Affiliates of
the Manager sponsor, advise and manage Other Angel Oak Accounts and may in the future sponsor, advise and manage additional Other Angel
Oak Accounts, and (ii)&nbsp;with respect to Other Angel Oak Accounts with investment objectives or guidelines that overlap with the Company&rsquo;s
but that do not have priority over the Company, the Manager and its Affiliates will allocate investment opportunities between the Company
and such Other Angel Oak Accounts in accordance with Angel Oak&rsquo;s prevailing policies and procedures on a basis that the Manager
and its Affiliates determine to be reasonable in their sole discretion, and there may be circumstances where investments that are consistent
with the Company&rsquo;s Investment Guidelines may be shared with or allocated to one or more Other Angel Oak Accounts in lieu of the
Company in accordance with Angel Oak&rsquo;s prevailing policies and procedures.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
connection with the services of the Manager hereunder, the Company and the Board acknowledge and agree that (i)&nbsp;as part of Angel
Oak&rsquo;s regular businesses, officers and personnel of the Manager and its Affiliates may from time-to-time work on other projects
and matters (including with respect to one or more Other Angel Oak Accounts), and that conflicts may arise with respect to the allocation
of personnel between the Company and one or more Other Angel Oak Accounts or the Manager and such other Affiliates, (ii)&nbsp;unless
prohibited by the Declaration of Trust, Other Angel Oak Accounts may, from time to time, invest in investments in which the Company has
an interest or in other transactions with companies or individuals that may be counterparties of the Company&rsquo;s, including through
Joint Ventures and co-investment arrangements, and while Angel Oak will seek to resolve any conflicts related thereto in a fair and reasonable
manner in accordance with its prevailing policies and procedures, there can be no assurance that any conflicts will be resolved in the
Company&rsquo;s favor, (iii)&nbsp;the Manager&rsquo;s Affiliates may from time to time receive fees related to investments in which the
Company has an interest or from companies or individuals that may be counterparties of the Company&rsquo;s, and while such fees may give
rise to conflicts of interest the Company will not receive the benefit of any such fees, and (iv)&nbsp;the terms and conditions of the
governing agreements of such Other Angel Oak Accounts (including with respect to the economic, reporting, and other rights afforded to
investors in such Other Angel Oak Accounts) are or may be materially different from the terms and conditions applicable to the Company,
the Shareholders, the Operating Partnership and Unitholders, and none of the Company, the Shareholders (in such capacity), the Operating
Partnership or the Unitholders (in such capacity) shall have the right to receive the benefit of any such different terms applicable
to investors in such Other Angel Oak Accounts as a result of an investment in the Company or otherwise. The Manager shall keep the Board
reasonably informed on a periodic basis in connection with the foregoing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 14; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->12<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager is not permitted to consummate on the Company&rsquo;s behalf any transaction that involves (i)&nbsp;the sale of any investment
to or (ii)&nbsp;the acquisition of any investment from Angel Oak, any Other Angel Oak Account or any of their Affiliates unless such
transaction is approved by a majority of the Trustees, including a majority of the Independent Trustees, not otherwise interested in
such transaction as being fair and reasonable to the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(e)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager will seek to resolve any conflicts of interest in a fair and reasonable manner in accordance with its prevailing policies and
procedures with respect to conflicts resolution among Other Angel Oak Accounts generally.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(f)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>For
the avoidance of doubt, it is understood that neither the Company nor the Board has the authority to determine the salary, bonus or any
other compensation paid by the Manager to any director, officer, member, partner, employee, or shareholder of the Manager or its Affiliates,
including any person who is also a Trustee or officer employee of the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">9.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Relationship
with Trustees and Officers</B></FONT>. Subject to Section&nbsp;7 of this Agreement and to restrictions advisable with respect to the
qualification of the Company as a REIT, directors, managers, officers and employees of the Manager or an Affiliate of the Manager or
any corporate parent of an Affiliate, may serve as a Trustee or officer of the Company, except that no director, officer or employee
of the Manager or its Affiliates who also is a Trustee or officer of the Company shall receive any compensation from the Company for
serving as a Trustee or officer other than (a)&nbsp;reasonable reimbursement for travel and related expenses incurred in attending meetings
of the Board or (b)&nbsp;as otherwise approved by the Board, including a majority of the Independent Trustees, and no such Trustee shall
be deemed an Independent Trustee for purposes of satisfying the Trustee independence requirement set forth in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">10.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Management
Fee</B></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Following
the Initial Closing, the Company will pay the Manager a management fee (the &ldquo;<U>Management Fee</U>&rdquo;) equal to 0.75% per annum
of the aggregate NAV represented by Series&nbsp;A shares, 1.25% per annum of the aggregate NAV represented by Series&nbsp;B shares, payable
monthly in arrears, within fifteen (15) days of the end of the relevant calendar month, before giving effect to any accruals for the
Management Fee, any Shareholder Servicing Fee, the Performance Participation Interest or any Distributions. Any Management Fee will be
calculated and paid to the Manager on a series-by-series basis, based on the NAV, which will be provided monthly by the Manager, of each
applicable type of Company shares. Additionally, to the extent that the Operating Partnership issues units to parties other than the
Company, the Operating Partnership will pay the Manager an annual management fee equal to 0.75% of the aggregate NAV represented by Series&nbsp;A
units and 1.25% of the aggregate NAV represented by Series&nbsp;B units, respectively, per annum and monthly in arrears, before giving
effect to any accruals for the Management Fee, any Shareholder Servicing Fee, the Performance Participation Interest or any Distributions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
connection with the establishment of additional series of Shares or Units, the Manager, the Company and/or the Operating Partnership,
as applicable, may agree to supplement this Section&nbsp;10 to provide for the calculation of the Management Fee payable in respect of
the NAV represented by such series of Shares or Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->13<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager may, in its sole discretion, waive, or otherwise cause to be rebated, a portion of the Management Fee attributable to a particular
series of Shares or Units. In connection with the Corbin Sub-Advisory Agreement, the Manager hereby agrees to waive, or otherwise cause
to be rebated, a portion of the Management Fee attributable to the Series&nbsp;A-I or A-II shares and the Series&nbsp;A-I or A-II units
(or such other series of shares or units, as agreed in writing between Corbin and the Manager) equal to the Corbin Waiver Amount.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager shall receive the Management Fee as compensation for services rendered hereunder. The Management Fee will be paid, at the Manager&rsquo;s
election, in cash, Shares or Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(e)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
the event this Agreement is terminated or its term expires without renewal, the Manager will be entitled to receive its prorated Management
Fee through the date of termination. Such proration shall take into account the number of days of any partial calendar month or calendar
year for which this Agreement was in effect.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(f)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
the event the Company or the Operating Partnership commences a liquidation of its Investments during any calendar year, the Company and
the Operating Partnership will pay the Manager the Management Fee from the proceeds of the liquidation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">11.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Expenses</B></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subject
to Sections&nbsp;4(e)&nbsp;and 11(b), the Manager shall be responsible for the expenses related to any and all personnel of the Manager
who provide investment advisory services to the Company pursuant to this Agreement (including, without limitation, each of the officers
of the Company and any Trustees who are also Trustees, officers or employees of the Manager or any of its Affiliates), including, without
limitation, salaries, bonus and other wages, payroll taxes and the cost of employee benefit plans of such personnel, and costs of insurance
with respect to such personnel (&ldquo;<U>Manager Expenses</U>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager has agreed to advance initial Organization and Offering Expenses (other than any Upfront Sales Load, any Shareholder Servicing
Fees, fees and expenses in connection with the Form&nbsp;10 registration statement and fees and expenses in connection with filings after
the Initial Closing under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) of each of the Company and the Operating Partnership through
the first anniversary of the Initial Closing. Except as set forth in this Section&nbsp;11 and in addition to the compensation paid to
the Manager pursuant to Section&nbsp;10 hereof, the Company or the Operating Partnership shall pay all of its costs and expenses directly
or reimburse the Manager or its Affiliates for costs and expenses of the Manager and its Affiliates incurred on behalf of the Company
or the Operating Partnership (other than Manager Expenses), which costs and expenses shall be reimbursed within thirty (30) days following
written request by the Manager. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, it is specifically agreed that the following costs
and expenses of the Company or the Operating Partnership are not Manager Expenses and shall be paid by the Company or the Operating Partnership
and shall not be paid by the Manager or Affiliates of the Manager:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(i)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Organization

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(xviii)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>expenses
incurred in connection with the formation, organization and continuation of any corporation, partnership, Joint Venture, securitization
trust, special purpose vehicle or other entity through which the Company&rsquo;s and/or the Operating Partnership&rsquo;s Investments
are made, financed or securitized, or in which any such entity invests.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager may, at its option, elect not to seek reimbursement for certain expenses during a given period, which determination shall not
be deemed to construe a waiver of reimbursement for similar expenses in future periods.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Any
reimbursement payments owed by the Company to the Manager may be offset by the Manager against amounts due to the Company from the Manager.
Cost and expense reimbursement to the Manager shall be subject to adjustment at the end of each calendar year in connection with the
annual audit of the Company. Any reimbursement payments will be paid, at the Manager&rsquo;s election, in cash, Shares or Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(e)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
the foregoing, the Manager shall pay for initial Organization and Offering Expenses (other than any Upfront Sales Load and any Shareholder
Servicing Fees) incurred through the first anniversary of the Initial Closing. All initial Organization and Offering Expenses (other
than any Upfront Sales Load, any Shareholder Servicing Fees, fees and expenses in connection with the Form&nbsp;10 registration statement
and fees and expenses in connection with filings after the Initial Closing under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) paid
by the Manager pursuant to this Section&nbsp;11(e)&nbsp;shall be reimbursed by the Company to the Manager in 60 equal monthly installments
commencing with the first anniversary of the Initial Closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">12.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Other
Services</B></FONT>. Should the Board request that the Manager or any director, officer or employee thereof render services for the Company
and the Operating Partnership other than set forth in Section&nbsp;3 and such services are permitted under the Declaration of Trust or
otherwise approved by the Board, such services shall be separately compensated at such rates and in such amounts as are agreed by the
Manager and the Board in accordance with the Declaration of Trust, and shall not be deemed to be services pursuant to the terms of this
Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">13.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>No
Joint Venture</B></FONT>. The Company and the Operating Partnership, on the one hand, and the Manager on the other, are not partners
or joint venturers with each other, and nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to make them such partners or joint venturers or
impose any liability as such on either of them.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">14.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Term
of Agreement</B></FONT>. This Agreement shall continue in force for a period of two years from the Effective Date, subject to an unlimited
number of successive one-year renewals upon mutual consent of the parties. It is the duty of the Board to evaluate the performance of
the Manager annually before renewing the Agreement, and each such renewal shall be for a term of no more than one year.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 19; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->17<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">15.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Termination
by the Parties</B></FONT>. This Agreement may be terminated (i)&nbsp;immediately by the Company or the Operating Partnership (x)&nbsp;for
Cause, (y)&nbsp;upon the bankruptcy of the Manager or (z)&nbsp;upon a material breach of this Agreement by the Manager where such breach
continues for a period of 90 days after written notice thereof specifying such breach and requesting that the same be remedied in such
90-day period (or 120 days after written notice of such breach if the Manager takes reasonable steps to cure such breach within 90 days
of the written notice); or (ii)&nbsp;upon 60 days&rsquo; written notice by the Manager. The provisions of Sections&nbsp;17 through 21
shall survive termination of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">16.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Assignment
to an Affiliate</B></FONT>. This Agreement may be assigned by the Manager to an Affiliate of the Manager with the approval of a majority
of the Trustees (including a majority of the Independent Trustees). The Manager may assign any rights to receive fees or other payments
under this Agreement to any Person without obtaining the consent of the Board. This Agreement shall not be assigned by the Company or
the Operating Partnership without the approval of the Manager, except in the case of an assignment by the Company or the Operating Partnership
to a corporation or other organization which is a successor to all of the assets, rights and obligations of the Company or the Operating
Partnership, in which case such successor organization shall be bound hereunder and by the terms of said assignment in the same manner
as the Company and the Operating Partnership are bound by this Agreement. This Agreement shall be binding on successors to the Company
or the Operating Partnership, and shall likewise be binding on any successor to the Manager.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">17.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Payments
to and Duties of Manager upon Termination</B></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>After
the Termination Date, the Manager shall not be entitled to compensation for further services hereunder except it shall be entitled to
receive from the Company or the Operating Partnership within 30 days after the effective date of such termination all unpaid reimbursements
of expenses and all earned but unpaid fees payable to the Manager prior to termination of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Manager shall promptly upon termination:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(i)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>pay
over to the Company and the Operating Partnership all money collected and held for the account of the Company and the Operating Partnership
pursuant to this Agreement, after deducting any accrued compensation and reimbursement for its expenses to which it is then entitled;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(ii)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>deliver
to the Board a full accounting, including a statement showing all payments collected by it and a statement of all money held by it, covering
the period following the date of the last accounting furnished to the Board;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iii)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>deliver
to the Board all assets, including all Investments, and documents of the Company and the Operating Partnership then in the custody of
the Manager; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iv)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>cooperate
with, and take all reasonable actions requested by, the Company and Board in making an orderly transition of the advisory function, in
each case at the Company&rsquo;s expense.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">18.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Indemnification
by the Company and the Operating Partnership</B></FONT>. The Company and the Operating Partnership shall indemnify and hold harmless
the Manager, any sub-advisor of the Manager and their Affiliates including their respective owners, officers, directors, partners and
employees from all liability, claims, damages or losses arising in the performance of their duties hereunder, and related expenses, including
reasonable attorneys&rsquo; fees, to the fullest extent possible without such indemnification being inconsistent with the laws of the
State of Maryland or the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">19.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Indemnification
by Manager</B></FONT>. The Manager shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company and the Operating Partnership from contract or other
liability, claims, damages, taxes or losses and related expenses including attorneys&rsquo; fees, to the extent that such liability,
claims, damages, taxes or losses and related expenses are not fully reimbursed by insurance and are incurred by reason of the Manager&rsquo;s
bad faith, fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence or reckless disregard of its duties under this Agreement; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>,
that the Manager shall not be held responsible for any action of the Board in following or declining to follow any advice or recommendation
given by the Manager.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">20.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Non-Solicitation</B></FONT>.
Following expiration of this Agreement, for two&nbsp;(2)&nbsp;years after the Termination Date, the Company shall not, without the consent
of the Manager, employ or otherwise retain any employee of the Manager or any of its Affiliates or any person who has been employed by
the Manager or any of its Affiliates at any time within the two&nbsp;(2)&nbsp;year period immediately preceding the date on which such
person commences employment with or is otherwise retained by the Company. The Company acknowledges and agrees that, in addition to any
damages, the Manager may be entitled to equitable relief for any violation of this Section&nbsp;20 by the Company, including, without
limitation, injunctive relief.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">21.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Miscellaneous</B></FONT>.</P>
